name: What is the typical timeline for a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3–12 months depending on project size; kitchens 4–8 weeks, full homes 6–12 months; factor in permits (2–8 weeks). blockrenovation+1
